title: Infection prevention and control
summary: How carers prevent and control infection in people's homes: PPE, hand hygiene, training and outbreaks.
whenToUse: Before winter, during an outbreak, or after an infection control audit finds problems.

statements.focus: Infection risks in the home: waste, laundry, equipment cleaning.
Infection control training and spot checks on hand hygiene and PPE.
Vaccinations and spotting signs of infection early.
IPC audits and the actions taken.
